BugsyText_INeverLose:
I'm BUGSY!
I never lose when

it comes to bug
#MON.

My research is
going to make me

the authority on
bug #MON!

Let me demonstrate
what I've learned from my studies.
BugsyText_ResearchIncomplete:
Whoa, amazing!
You're an expert on #MON!

My research isn't
complete yet.

OK, you win. Take
this BADGE.
BugsyText_HiveBadgeSpeech:
Do you know the
benefits of HIVE- BADGE?

If you have it,
#MON up to L30

will obey you,
even traded ones.

#MON that know
CUT will be able

to use it outside
of battle too.

Here, I also want
you to have this.
BugsyText_FuryCutterSpeech:
TM49 contains
FURY CUTTER.

If you don't miss,
it gets stronger every turn.

The longer your
battle goes, the better it gets.

Isn't that great?
I discovered it!
BugsyText_BugMonsAreDeep:
Bug #MON are
deep. There are

many mysteries to
be explored.

Study your favor-
ites thoroughly.
BugCatcherBennySeenText:
Bug #MON evolve
young. So they get

stronger that much
faster.
BugCatcherBennyAfterBattleText:
#MON become
stronger if they evolve. Really!
BugCatcherAlSeenText:
Bug #MON are
cool and tough!

I'll prove it to
you!
BugCatcherAlBeatenText:
You proved how
tough you are…
BugCatcherAlAfterBattleText:
They're so cool,
but most girls

don't like bug
#MON.

I don't know why…
BugCatcherJoshSeenText:
You saved all the
SLOWPOKE? Whew, you're mighty!

But my grown-up
#MON are pretty tough too!
BugCatcherJoshAfterBattleText:
I guess I should
teach them better moves…
TwinsAmyandmay1SeenText:
AMY: Hi! Are you
challenging the LEADER? No way!
TwinsAmyandmay2SeenText:
MAY: You want to
see the LEADER? We come first!
TwinsAmyandmay2AfterBattleText:
MAY: Our bug #-
MON lost! Oh, what a shame.
AzaleaGymGuideText:
Yo, challenger!

BUGSY's young, but
his knowledge of

bug #MON is for
real.

It's going to be
tough without my advice.

Let's see… Bug
#MON don't like fire.

Flying-type moves
are super-effec- tive too.
AzaleaGymGuideWinText:
Well done! That
was a great clash

of talented young
trainers.

With people like
you, the future of #MON is bright!
